_comment: Keyed by service name only. This KB deliberately contains NO per-host patch status. Resolving whether a given host is affected requires joining a running version (get_asset_info) against affected_versions here. See CLAUDE.md section 5.1.

mysql.description: Improper neutralisation of crafted UNION payloads in the MySQL Server parser component. Permits authentication bypass and arbitrary read of arbitrary tables by an unauthenticated remote attacker.
Improper input validation in the MySQL Server replication subsystem permitting remote denial of service. Does not permit data disclosure.

apache.description: Path traversal and file disclosure in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49/2.4.50 when files outside the document root are not protected by 'require all denied'.

tomcat.description: Ghostcat. The AJP connector permits reading of arbitrary files under the web application root and, where upload is permitted, remote code execution.

openssh.description: regreSSHion. Signal handler race condition in OpenSSH server permitting unauthenticated remote code execution as root on glibc-based Linux.
